name: Vaccinations
overview: The Scriptures remind us of the sacredness of life, as Leviticus 17:11 teaches that the life of the flesh is in the blood, which God has given for atonement and preservation of the soul. Trusting in God's protection, as Psalm 91:1 encourages us to dwell securely in His presence, we are called to seek peace and well-being in our communities (Jeremiah 29:7). While the Bible does not directly address vaccinations, these verses guide believers to honor life and pursue health under God's care.
